# device42_auto_discovery_dns (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_dns" "myDnsJob" {
   zonename      = "example.local"
   nameserver    = "ns1.example.local"
   schedule_time = "02:00"
   schedule_days = "0,1,2,3,4,5,6"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nameserver` (String) IP or FQDN of the nameserver. Create only.
- `zonename` (String) Zone name to discover. Create only (the API upserts by name).

### Optional

- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0). Create only.
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job. Create only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

Note: All fields of this resource are create only (ForceNew). The API does not support updating a DNS autodiscovery job in place, it always creates a new job. As a result, any change to the configuration recreates the job.
